mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of declining FEDFUNDS instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of UNRATE >5.0% instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through demand-side momentum.
